title: Gaétane Baudry Joins Bobbi Brown to Lead Brand’s Next Growth Chapter
summary: Estée Lauder Cos. appoints Gaétane Baudry to helm Bobbi Brown, focusing on global strategy, innovation and consumer engagement to drive the brand's next era of growth.
